# Built to Run
> Book by Dr. Connor Robertson on building businesses that operate without you.

## About
Built to Run by Dr. Connor Robertson provides a blueprint for creating businesses with systems and processes that run independently. The book covers delegation, automation, team building, and operational frameworks for business owners who want freedom from day-to-day operations.
